imo4.title: Fourth IMO GHG Study 2020, Annex Tables 75–81: average days at sea by ship type and size class, 2012–2018

assume.title: Modelling assumption of this application; documented in docs/decisions/0008

days_source.note: Most likely days at sea = the study's 2018 average for the ship's type and size class; the 2012–2018 range sets the spread.

individual_spread.note: Individual ships differ from their class average: the 2012–2018 range of class averages is widened by ±25% for the minimum and maximum.

max_days.note: Upper limit for days at sea in a year (time for drydock and port calls).

eu_dominant_threshold.note: At or above this most-likely EU share the ship is treated as trading mainly in the EU and its recorded data as complete.
